description: Override the current time-range filter. Latest set_time op wins during replay. Covers requests like "filter to 2020-2024" or "show only the last 7 days". Not yet consumed by the renderer — the UI drives the slider directly — but the value is captured in the ops log and queryable via get_state.

field.description: Feature property carrying the time value (e.g. "date", "year", "timestamp").

format.description: How rangeStart/rangeEnd encode time. Default: unix_ms at render time.

rangeEnd.description: Inclusive upper bound of the visible window.

rangeStart.description: Inclusive lower bound of the visible window.

rationale.description: Optional short label (≤300 chars) for the map edit history, e.g. "add wildfire layer". Omit it to send nothing beyond the tool arguments.

name: set_time
title: Set the time window (direct)
